function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask to compute the standard deviation? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" which might mean "standard deviation of the sampling distribution under the null hypothesis"? Or maybe they want the standard error? Let's parse: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (standard error) for the null hypothesis test? The phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get the population mean of 98.6". So they want to test H0: μ = 98.6 vs Ha: μ ≠ 98.6. They have sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, n=40. They want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under H0? That would be σ/√n. But we don't know population sigma; we use sample sigma as estimate. So standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Compute sqrt(40)=6.3249. 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. So standard error ~0.221. Then compute t-statistic: (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = -0.4/0.2213 = -1.807. Then p-value two-tailed: 2*P(T>1.807) with df=39. Using t distribution. Let's approximate: For df=39, t=1.807 gives p ~0.089? Let's check approximate: t=1.68 gives p=0.10; t=1.88 gives p=0.07. So p ~0.09. So p-value ~0.09. But the question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They might want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (standard error). So answer: 0.221. Or maybe they want to compute the p-value. The tool provided calculates p-value. We can call the function. Provide arguments: sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40, two_tailed=true. Then get p-value. Let's do that.
